Leah (eng-platform): Quick sync — we need to lock a single client-facing error payload shape for routing/quota/fallbacks. Proposal below, very small and stable so SDKs can parse it

Matt R (eng-runtime): +1 on a stable shape. One callout: differentiate HTTP status vs semantic code. 429 for rate limits, 503 for backend overload/routing fallback, 403 for quota/auth issues?

Ana (Product): Console/UI needs a usable copy mapping. We can't surface raw codes to users. e.g. 429 -> 'Rate limit exceeded, try again in 30s' or link to billing page for quota hits.

Rohit (eng-telemetry): Telemetry needs a canonical set of tags: error_class, error_code, route, model_variant, is_fallback (bool), region, quota_bucket. Also strip any user text from logs to avoid PII.

Jin (devex): Suggest using short string codes (snake_case) in payloads so SDKs don't have to map numbers. e.g. "rate_limit", "quota_exceeded", "routing_fallback". Keep HTTP status at top-level for intermediaries.

Leah (eng-platform): Agreed. Minimal schema idea:

```json
{
  "status": 429,
  "code": "rate_limit",
  "message": "Rate limit exceeded",
  "retry_after": 30,
  "docs_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate_limit",
  "user_action": "reduce-request-rate"
}
```

Matt R (eng-runtime): Edge case: when routing falls back to a cheaper model we might return 200 + a warning. We should decide whether routing degradations are errors or soft warnings.

Ana (Product): UX preference: surface a non-blocking banner for soft degradations (200 + warning.code = "routing_fallback"). Only block with 4xx/5xx. Keep messaging consistent across API and Console.

Rohit (eng-telemetry): For warnings include telemetry tag warning_class and increase sampling on them so we can correlate regressions. Also emit metric redwood.errors.count{error_code=...,is_fallback=...}.

Jin (devex): For SDKs propose: parse numeric status, then map the string code to enums. Also add an HTTP header X-Redwood-Error-Code for quick routing without body parsing. Backcompat: if header present prefer it, else read body.

Leah (eng-platform): Rollout plan suggestion: Phase 1 (api): adopt payload shape + header for all new error paths. Phase 2 (console & docs): map codes -> human copy and telemetry dashboards. We'll gate with feature flag for 2 weeks then flip.

Matt R (eng-runtime): We'll add server-side tests and a lint that enforces code values against a canonical list (errors.yml).

Ana (Product): Timeline request: can we get Phase 1 in 3 weeks? Console copy + dashboards in 6?

Leah (eng-platform): 3 weeks is tight but feasible for a first pass. I'll create a PR with the schema + canonical list today.

sre-bot: Reminder: add new error codes to infra/errors.yml and run the integration lint before merging.

Rohit (eng-telemetry): One more: please include a sampling hint in responses for high-volume non-blocking warnings so we can capture examples. e.g. "sample_hint": 0.01

Leah (eng-platform): Noted — adding sample_hint and documentation URL to the schema. Thanks all, I'll open the RFC and invite SDK/console owners.
